core_obligations: The support Z of the test sheaf is finite over k, so pr_{2,*} is faithful on modules supported on Z x Y; the hypotheses transfer vanishing from the pushed objects to the tensor products.
Stalkwise reduction modulo powers of the maximal ideal plus the algebra lemma gives the degree bounds for K_{n,z} at all closed points.
Transition maps are isomorphisms on the middle window for n > 2m; in the smooth case the split lemma produces the decomposition for n > 2m + dim.
proof_roadmap: Transfer from fibres via faithfulness, lift boundedness stalkwise, then split in the smooth case.
difficulty_reason: Support-based transfer argument plus a Kollar-Kovacs type algebra lemma and a split conclusion; heavy but fully displayed.
